about: Intended, ruled differences from the edge-recorded golden (vote-path-golden.json), one entry per changed case. See the header of __tests__/integration/vote-path-recordings.test.ts. Emptied whenever the golden is re-recorded on edge.

entries.whole_response_reason: The recorded response was the bug (#2952): the owner, pid 0, was served their own already-voted statement with remaining equal to total. Nothing is left for the owner, so the whole response becomes the existing no-statement response.
entries.why: GET /nextComment honours pid 0 (the first participant): it no longer offers statements that participant has already voted on, and counts remaining against their votes (#2956).
